pageTitle: New Mexico Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What Are the Requirements to Buy Lottery Tickets in New Mexico?
items.answer:
Players 18 and older and present in New Mexico can buy a ticket or New Mexico lottery scratch card at a participating retailer. Online sales are not possible. There is a handy New Mexico Lottery app that acts as a New Mexico lottery ticket scanner and provides information on New Mexico lottery codes.

 

A My Rewards account lets you scan non-winning tickets, check New Mexico lottery results, and keep track of draws.

items.question: What Lottery Games Can You Play in New Mexico?
items.answer:
Lottery in New Mexico offers seven different games. Interestingly, there is no New Mexico lottery Lucky for Life game on offer. The popular statewide games of Powerball and Mega Millions are available, as well as some other notable titles:

 

Lotto America – Choose five numbers from 1-52

Roadrunner Cash – Choose five numbers from 1-37

Lucky Numbers Bingo – Choose from ten lucky numbers to match bingo patterns

Pick 4 – Choose four numbers from 0-9

Pick 3 – Choose three numbers from 0-9

items.question: Where and How Do I Claim Winnings from the New Mexico Lottery?
items.answer: When a player checks the New Mexico lottery results and finds a prize up to $600 was won, that prize may be claimed from a participating retailer or through the mail.  Prizes over $600 must be claimed at Lottery Headquarters, or through the mail using a claim form.

items.question: How Do You Play and Win in the New Mexico Lottery?
items.answer: The New Mexico Lottery numbers need to match your selection. For instance, Lotto America requires a player to pick five numbers between 1-52. The objective is to predict which five numbers will appear in the draw. Smaller cash prizes can also be won with as little as two New Mexico Lottery winning numbers.

items.question: What Are the Odds of Winning the New Mexico Lottery?
items.answer:
The odds of winning the New Mexico lottery Mega Millions jackpot are 1 in 302 million. For the New Mexico Lottery Powerball, it is 1 in 175 million. Other odds are as follows:

 

Lotto America – 1 in 26 million

Roadrunner Cash – 1 in 435,897

Lucky Numbers Bingo – 1 in 3.35

Pick 4 – 10 000

Pick 3 – 1 in 1000

items.question: What’s the Biggest New Mexico Lottery Win?
items.answer: The luckiest ticket bought in New Mexico was a Powerball ticket that won $206.9 million in 2008. The winner(s) chose to stay anonymous.

items.question: When Is the New Mexico Lottery Results Draw?
items.answer:
The results of the New Mexico lottery become available as follows:

 

Lotto America: Wednesdays and Saturdays at 9:15 pm

Roadrunner Cash: Daily at 9:30 pm

Lucky Numbers Bingo: Daily every four minutes

Pick 4 and Pick 3: 1:30 pm and 9:30 pm

items.question: What Is the New Mexico Lottery Second Chance?
items.answer: If your New Mexico lottery scratch card didn’t win or missed out on the New Mexico lottery winning numbers, New Mexico Lottery Second Chance may come to the rescue. Non-winning scratchers, Roadrunner Cash, and Pick 3 tickets can be scanned using the New Mexico lottery app or website. Each month, $5 000 cash and 300 win points are awarded.

items.question: Do I Have to Pay Tax on New Mexico Lottery Winnings?
items.answer: New Mexico lottery winners pay a state tax of 6%. On top of that, federal taxes are payable. These have a top tier of 37%.
